mapper.select: SELECT T.ACTIVE_COUNT , T.UPCOMING_COUNT , T.ENDED_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CS.USER_ID) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS INNER JOIN COURSE C2 ON C2.ID = CS.COURSE_ID WHERE C2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(C2.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C2.END_DATED)) AS ACTIVE_STUDENT_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CT.TUTOR_ID) FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT INNER JOIN COURSE C3 ON C3.ID = CT.COURSE_ID INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CT.TUTOR_ID WHERE C3.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(C3.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C3.END_DATED)) AS ACTIVE_TUTOR_COUNT FROM (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED) THEN 1 END) AS ACTIVE_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(C.START_DATE) THEN 1 END) AS UPCOMING_COUNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(C.END_DATED) THEN 1 END) AS ENDED_COUNT FROM COURSE C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N') T

SELECT C.ID , C.COURSE_NAME , TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE , TO_CHAR(C.END_DATED, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATED , (SELECT LISTAGG(U.NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY U.NAME) FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT INNER JOIN "USER" U ON U.ID = CT.TUTOR_ID WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.ID) AS TUTOR_NAMES , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COURSE_STUDENT CS WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = C.ID) AS STUDENT_COUNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEST_ANSWERS TA INNER JOIN TEST_SET TS ON TS.ID = TA.TEST_SET_ID WHERE TS.COURSE_ID = C.ID AND TA.IS_CORRECT = 'R') AS PENDING_ANSWERS FROM COURSE C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED) ORDER BY C.END_DATED ASC, C.ID ASC

SELECT 'NO_TIMETABLE' AS CHECK_TYPE, C.ID AS COURSE_ID, C.COURSE_NAME, NULL AS DETAIL FROM COURSE C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) <= TRUNC(C.END_DATED) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TIME_TABLE TT WHERE TT.COURSE_ID = C.ID AND TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED)) UNION ALL SELECT 'NO_TUTOR', C.ID, C.COURSE_NAME, NULL FROM COURSE C WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) <= TRUNC(C.END_DATED) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TUTOR CT WHERE CT.COURSE_ID = C.ID) UNION ALL SELECT 'INVALID_TUTOR', C.ID, C.COURSE_NAME, CT.TUTOR_ID FROM COURSE C INNER JOIN COURSE_TUTOR CT ON CT.COURSE_ID = C.ID WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) <= TRUNC(C.END_DATED) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "USER" U WHERE U.ID = CT.TUTOR_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N') UNION ALL SELECT 'TIMETABLE_OUT_OF_PERIOD', C.ID, C.COURSE_NAME, TO_CHAR(COUNT(DISTINCT TRUNC(TT.DATETIME))) FROM COURSE C INNER JOIN COURSE_TIME_TABLE TT ON TT.COURSE_ID = C.ID WHERE C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND TRUNC(TT.DATETIME) NOT BETWEEN TRUNC(C.START_DATE) AND TRUNC(C.END_DATED) GROUP BY C.ID, C.COURSE_NAME ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT R.ROLE_ID , R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME , COUNT(U.ID) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM "ROLE" R LEFT JOIN "USER" U ON U.BASE_ROLE = R.ROLE_ID AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY R.ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_DISPLAY_NAME, R.ROLE_RANK ORDER BY R.ROLE_RANK
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "USER" WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND LOGIN_BLOCK_DATE > SYSDATE
SELECT DISTINCT A.ACTION_CODE FROM ACTION A WHERE A.ACTION_CODE IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ROLE_ACTION RA WHERE RA.ACTION_ID = A.ACTION_ID) ORDER BY A.ACTION_CODE
